# Abbacy Global Group — Study Abroad & Overseas Education Consultancy

> Abbacy Global Group is Hyderabad's premier overseas education consultancy with 15+ years of operational excellence, an industry-leading 99.2% student visa success rate, and 10,000+ placed alumni across top global universities in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, France, Netherlands, and Dubai. Headquartered at Himayatnagar, Hyderabad, Abbacy provides 100% free personalized counseling, university shortlisting across 500+ global partner institutions, test preparation waivers (IELTS/PTE/GRE), collateral-free education loans up to ₹50 Lakhs, Telangana ePASS ₹20 Lakhs scholarship assistance, and daily 1-on-1 consular mock interviews.

## Country Destinations & Intake Guides (Spring 2027 / Fall 2027)

- [Study in USA Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-usa.html): Complete guide to American universities, F-1 visa approvals, STEM OPT (up to 36 months work authorization), GRE waivers, Day-1 CPT policies, and average starting salaries ($85,000–$120,000/yr).
- [Study in UK Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk.html): Intensive 1-year Master's programs, Russell Group university admissions (Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, UCL), 2-year post-study Graduate Route work visa, CAS issuance, and £2,000–£10,000 merit scholarships.
- [Study in Canada Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-canada.html): 2026/2027 IRCC rules, Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) process, Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP up to 3 years), Co-op work programs, and Express Entry PR score building.
- [Study in Australia Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-australia.html): Group of Eight (Go8) university applications, Subclass 500 student visa, Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate work rights, regional migration incentives, and high minimum wage protections.
- [Study in Germany Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-germany.html): Tuition-free education (€0 tuition) at public universities (TU9), mandatory APS certificate verification, €11,904/year blocked account (Ausländerbehörde requirement), and 18-month Job Seeker Visa.
- [Study in Ireland Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-ireland.html): Europe's English-speaking tech capital (Silicon Docks Dublin), 1-year Master's, 2-year Stamp 1G post-study work visa, and fast-track Critical Skills Employment Permits.
- [Study in France Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-france.html): Subsidized tuition (€2,770–€3,770/yr) at public universities, Grande École business schools, CAF accommodation housing allowance (up to 40% rent rebate), and 5-year post-study Schengen circulation visa.
- [Study in Netherlands Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-netherlands.html): Over 2,100 English-taught programs, 1-year Zoekjaar (Orientation Year) work visa, high graduate employment in European tech hubs (Amsterdam, Eindhoven).
- [Study in Dubai Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai.html): International branch campuses (Heriot-Watt, Wollongong, Birmingham, Middlesex), 0% personal income tax, fast 15-day visa approval without IELTS, and direct GCC employment opportunities.

## Specialized Dubai & UK Topical Master Guides (2026–2027)

### Dubai Topical Master Guides
- [Study in Dubai Without IELTS](https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai-without-ielts.html): Complete guide to MOI certificates from JNTU/OU, Class 12 English waivers (65%+), and direct admissions without IELTS.
- [UAE Student Visa Process from Hyderabad](https://abbacy.in/uae-student-visa-process-hyderabad.html): Step-by-step 3 to 7 day university-sponsored GDRFA e-visa, zero consulate interviews, and 99.8% approval rate.
- [Dubai to UK & Australia Transfer Pathway](https://abbacy.in/dubai-to-uk-australia-transfer-pathway.html): 1+1 and 2+1 twinning programs. Start in Dubai with lower fees and transfer to UK/Australia parent campus with full PSW rights.
- [Top Universities in Dubai & Fees in INR](https://abbacy.in/top-universities-in-dubai-fees-for-indian-students.html): Transparent tuition fees in AED & INR for Heriot-Watt, Birmingham, UOWD, Middlesex, BITS Pilani, plus 20%–50% merit scholarships.
- [MBA in Dubai for Indian Students](https://abbacy.in/mba-in-dubai-for-indian-students.html): Top business schools (SP Jain, Edinburgh Business School, UOWD), GMAT waivers, and 0% tax corporate packages in DIFC (AED 15k–25k/mo).
- [Part-Time Jobs & Monthly Living Cost in Dubai](https://abbacy.in/part-time-jobs-and-living-cost-in-dubai.html): 20 hrs/week legal student work permits, hourly pay rates (AED 25–50/hr), and monthly student budget breakdown in INR (₹55k–₹70k).
- [Study in Dubai After 12th](https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai-after-12th.html): Direct Bachelor's admissions (B.Tech, BBA, Architecture) without JEE Main or TS EAMCET, accepting CBSE, ICSE, and TSBIE Intermediate marks.

### United Kingdom (UK) Topical Master Guides
- [Study in UK Without IELTS](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk-without-ielts.html): 25+ top UK universities waiving IELTS based on Class 12 English (70%+ from CBSE/ICSE/TSBIE).
- [UK Master's with Placement Year (2-Yr MS)](https://abbacy.in/uk-masters-with-placement-year.html): 1 year study + 1 year paid corporate placement (£18k–£26k) + 2 years Graduate Route PSW = 4 years total in the UK.
- [UK Student Visa Financial Proof (28-Day Rule)](https://abbacy.in/uk-student-visa-financial-proof-28-day-rule.html): Strict UKVI maintenance guidelines: Outer London (£9,207) vs Inner London (£12,006), approved Indian banks, and education loans.
- [UK January / Spring Intake Universities](https://abbacy.in/uk-january-spring-intake-universities.html): List of 70+ UK universities open for January 2027 admissions, CAS deadlines, and avoid gap years.
- [MS in UK Cost in INR & Merit Scholarships](https://abbacy.in/ms-in-uk-cost-and-scholarships.html): Total itemized budget for 1-year Master's, living expenses, NHS healthcare surcharges, and £2,000–£10,000 automatic merit scholarships.
- [MSc Data Science & Computer Science in UK](https://abbacy.in/msc-data-science-computer-science-uk.html): Top tech universities, AI/Data curricula, conversion programs for non-CS grads, and £38k+ starting tech salaries.
- [Study in UK with Study Gap (2 to 10 Years)](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk-after-study-gap.html): Gap justifications (corporate experience, UPSC/Govt prep, family business, medical), required documents, and gap-friendly universities.
- [Study in UK vs Study in Dubai Decider](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk-vs-study-in-dubai.html): Direct head-to-head comparison: total cost in INR, visa speeds (3 days vs 3 weeks), 0% tax vs £11.44 min wage, and career outcomes.

## Critical Student Support Hubs

- [IELTS Coaching in Hyderabad](https://abbacy.in/ielts-coaching-in-hyderabad.html): Band 7.5+ classroom and online training in Himayatnagar with daily 1-on-1 speaking evaluation and British Council / IDP test registration.
- [GRE Coaching in Hyderabad](https://abbacy.in/gre-coaching-hyderabad.html): Target 320+ score for US MS in Computer Science & Data Science with quantitative shortcut tactics.
- [PTE Academic Coaching in Hyderabad](https://abbacy.in/pte-academic-coaching-hyderabad.html): AI computer-scoring template mastery for Australia, UK, and Canada visas (target 65+ and 79+).
- [Duolingo English Test Accepted Universities](https://abbacy.in/duolingo-english-test-accepted-universities.html): Directory of 4,500+ global universities accepting DET scores of 105 to 125.
- [Scholarship Portal & Telangana ePASS Guide](https://abbacy.in/guide-scholarships.html): Eligibility rules and documentation for Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi (SC/ST) and Mahatma Jyothiba Phule BC Overseas Scholarship (up to ₹20,00,000 grants plus one-way airfare), plus global institutional merit discounts.
- [Collateral-Free Education Loan Guide](https://abbacy.in/guide-loans.html): Unsecured education loans up to ₹50–60 Lakhs, secured loans up to ₹1.5 Crore via SBI, HDFC Credila, Axis Bank, Avanse, and international non-collateral lenders (Prodigy Finance, MPOWER Financing).
- [English Language Exam Matrix (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL/Duolingo)](https://abbacy.in/guide-ielts.html): Score benchmarks (IELTS 6.5+, PTE 58+, DET 115+), band comparisons, preparation modules, and official Medium of Instruction (MOI) waiver pathways.
- [US Master's Application Roadmap](https://abbacy.in/guide-usa.html): Month-by-month timeline for Fall and Spring intakes, SOP/LOR drafting criteria, I-20 financial documentation, and DS-160 interview question frameworks.
- [Online Profile Eligibility Evaluator](https://abbacy.in/eligibility.html): Instant 60-second evaluation engine matching GPA/percentage, backlog count, budget, and test scores to global university admission criteria.
- [About Our Counsellor Team & Leadership](https://abbacy.in/about-our-team.html): Profiles of certified study abroad directors and advisors (Alisha, Laxmi, Gopi), 15+ years institutional track record across 10,000+ placed students, and methodology behind our 99% visa approval rate.
- [Contact & In-Person Consultation Booking](https://abbacy.in/contact.html): Book a 1-on-1 counseling session with a senior study abroad director at our Himayatnagar, Hyderabad headquarters.
